title: In-Home Hospice Care
summary: In-home hospice care is for patients with a life-limiting illness and the families caring for them.

title: Hospice in Assisted Living & Skilled Nursing
summary: This service is for residents of assisted living, skilled nursing and board and care communities.

title: Levels of Hospice Care
summary: Medicare defines four levels of hospice care.

title: 24/7 Nurse Access
summary: 24/7 nurse access gives enrolled patients and families a way to reach hospice nursing support by phone at any hour.

title: Hospice Care for Dementia
summary: Hospice care for dementia is for patients in the later stages of Alzheimer's or another dementia and the families beside them.

title: Hospice Care for Advanced Cancer
summary: This service is for patients with advanced cancer who are focusing on comfort.

title: Hospice Care for Heart Failure
summary: This service is for patients with advanced heart failure and the families caring for them.

title: Respiratory Care
summary: Respiratory support within hospice is for eligible patients with COPD, lung disease or heart failure who experience shortness of breath.

title: Bereavement Support
summary: Bereavement support is for family members and close loved ones affected by the loss of a person in hospice care.

title: Hospice Evaluation
summary: A hospice evaluation is for families, physicians and hospitals considering hospice for a patient.
